de.title: An Ort und Stelle gefangen: Wie eine 5-Prozent-Rendite von Staatsanleihen Hausbesitzer an ihre Hypotheken bindet

segments.src: Long-term interest rates have climbed to levels not seen in many years, and the effects are showing up far from Wall Street.
segments.tr: Langfristige Zinssätze sind auf ein Niveau gestiegen, das seit vielen Jahren nicht mehr gesehen wurde, und die Auswirkungen zeigen sich weit entfernt von der Wall Street.

segments.src: With the 10-year Treasury yield hovering around 5%, millions of American homeowners are making a quiet calculation: giving up a cheap mortgage is simply not worth it.
segments.tr: Da die Rendite 10-jähriger US-Staatsanleihen bei rund 5 % liegt, stellen Millionen amerikanischer Hausbesitzer eine stille Rechnung auf: Eine günstige Hypothek aufzugeben, lohnt sich einfach nicht.

segments.src: The result is a housing market where few people sell, few homes are listed, and prices remain stubbornly high.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis ist ein Immobilienmarkt, auf dem nur wenige Menschen verkaufen, kaum Häuser gelistet werden und die Preise hartnäckig hoch bleiben.

segments.src: ## What Is the "Lock-In Effect"?
segments.tr: ## Was ist der "Lock-in-Effekt"?

segments.src: The lock-in effect describes a situation in which homeowners stay in their homes mainly because moving would mean replacing a low-rate mortgage with a much more expensive one.
segments.tr: Der Lock-in-Effekt beschreibt eine Situation, in der Hausbesitzer hauptsächlich deshalb in ihren Häusern bleiben, weil ein Umzug bedeuten würde, eine zinsgünstige Hypothek durch eine viel teurere zu ersetzen.

segments.src: Many households refinanced or bought when 30-year fixed rates sat near 3% or 4%.
segments.tr: Viele Haushalte haben refinanziert oder gekauft, als die festen 30-Jahres-Zinsen bei etwa 3 % oder 4 % lagen.

segments.src: Today, new mortgage rates typically track the 10-year Treasury yield plus a spread, so a Treasury yield near 5% generally pushes new mortgage rates well above where many existing borrowers are.
segments.tr: Heutzutage orientieren sich die Zinsen für neue Hypotheken typischerweise an der Rendite 10-jähriger Staatsanleihen zuzüglich eines Aufschlags, sodass eine Staatsanleihenrendite nahe 5 % die neuen Hypothekenzinsen im Allgemeinen deutlich über das Niveau treibt, auf dem sich viele bestehende Kreditnehmer befinden.

segments.src: For a household with a low-rate loan, the math is stark.
segments.tr: Für einen Haushalt mit einem zinsgünstigen Darlehen ist die Rechnung nüchtern.

segments.src: Taking on a new mortgage of the same size at a significantly higher rate can add hundreds of dollars to the monthly payment, even before accounting for the price of the next home.
segments.tr: Die Aufnahme einer neuen Hypothek gleicher Höhe zu einem deutlich höheren Zinssatz kann die monatliche Rate um Hunderte von Dollars erhöhen, noch bevor der Preis des nächsten Hauses berücksichtigt wird.

segments.src: ## Why a 5% Treasury Yield Matters
segments.tr: ## Warum eine 5-Prozent-Staatsanleihenrendite wichtig ist

segments.src: Mortgage rates are not set directly by the Federal Reserve.
segments.tr: Hypothekenzinsen werden nicht direkt von der Notenbank festgelegt.

segments.src: They follow the bond market, and the 10-year Treasury yield is the benchmark most closely watched.
segments.tr: Sie folgen dem Anleihemarkt, und die Rendite 10-jähriger Staatsanleihen ist der am genaueesten beobachtete Maßstab.

segments.src: When that yield rises, lenders generally price mortgages higher.
segments.tr: Wenn diese Rendite steigt, verlangen Kreditgeber im Allgemeinen höhere Hypothekenzinsen.

segments.src: A sustained move toward 5% signals that borrowing costs could stay elevated for longer than many buyers and sellers had hoped.
segments.tr: Ein anhaltender Trend Richtung 5 % signalisiert, dass die Kreditkosten länger erhöht bleiben könnten, als viele Käufer und Verkäufer gehofft hatten.

segments.src: Several forces can keep long-term yields high:
segments.tr: Mehrere Kräfte können die langfristigen Renditen hoch halten:

segments.src: - **Inflation expectations:** If investors worry price growth will remain firm, they demand higher yields.
segments.tr: - **Inflationserwartungen:** Wenn Investoren befürchten, dass das Preiswachstum stark bleibt, fordern sie höhere Renditen.

segments.src: - **Government borrowing:** Heavy issuance of Treasury debt can push yields up as the market absorbs more supply.
segments.tr: - **Staatliche Kreditaufnahme:** Eine starke Emission von Staatsschulden kann die Renditen nach oben treiben, da der Markt mehr Angebot aufnimmt.

segments.src: - **Monetary policy outlook:** Expectations that short-term rates will stay higher for longer can lift yields across the curve.
segments.tr: - **Ausblick auf die Geldpolitik:** Die Erwartung, dass die kurzfristigen Zinsen länger höher bleiben, kann die Renditen über die gesamte Kurve anheben.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Sellers
segments.tr: ## Was es für Verkäufer bedeutet

segments.src: Sellers with low-rate mortgages face a trade-off.
segments.tr: Verkäufer mit zinsgünstigen Hypotheken stehen vor einem Kompromiss.

segments.src: Selling may unlock equity, but the next purchase will likely come with a higher monthly payment.
segments.tr: Ein Verkauf mag Eigenkapital freisetzen, aber der nächste Kauf ist wahrscheinlich mit einer höheren monatlichen Rate verbunden.

segments.src: Many choose to stay, renovate, or rent out the property instead.
segments.tr: Viele ziehen es stattdessen vor zu bleiben, zu renovieren oder die Immobilie zu vermieten.

segments.src: Those who must move, because of a job change, a growing family, a divorce, or retirement, often accept the cost, but they represent a smaller share of potential sellers than in typical years.
segments.tr: Diejenigen, die umziehen müssen – aufgrund eines Jobwechsels, einer wachsenden Familie, einer Scheidung oder des Ruhestands –, akzeptieren oft die Kosten, machen jedoch einen kleineren Anteil potenzieller Verkäufer aus als in typischen Jahren.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Buyers
segments.tr: ## Was es für Käufer bedeutet

segments.src: For buyers, the lock-in effect creates a double challenge: higher borrowing costs and limited choice.
segments.tr: Für Käufer schafft der Lock-in-Effekt eine doppelte Herausforderung: höhere Kreditkosten und eine begrenzte Auswahl.

segments.src: When fewer homes come to market, competition for each listing stays strong, which supports prices even when demand is weaker than in past cycles.
segments.tr: Wenn weniger Häuser auf den Markt kommen, bleibt der Wettbewerb um jedes Angebot stark, was die Preise stützt, selbst wenn die Nachfrage schwächer ist als in vergangenen Zyklen.

segments.src: Affordability measures, which combine price, rate and income, remain strained for many first-time buyers.
segments.tr: Die Erschwinglichkeitsindikatoren, die Preis, Zinssatz und Einkommen kombinieren, bleiben für viele Erstkäufer angespannt.

segments.src: Buyers are responding in several ways:
segments.tr: Käufer reagieren auf verschiedene Weise:

segments.src: - Widening their search to more affordable regions or smaller homes.
segments.tr: - Ausweitung ihrer Suche auf günstigere Regionen oder kleinere Häuser.

segments.src: - Considering new construction, where builders sometimes offer rate buydowns or incentives.
segments.tr: - Inanspruchnahme von Neubauten, bei denen Bauträger manchmal Zinsverbilligungen oder Anreize anbieten.

segments.src: - Exploring adjustable-rate or assumable loans, each of which carries its own risks and conditions.
segments.tr: - Erkundung von variabel verzinslichen oder übernehmbaren Darlehen, die jeweils ihre eigenen Risiken und Bedingungen bergen.

segments.src: - Saving for larger down payments to reduce monthly costs.
segments.tr: - Ansparen für größere Anzahlungen, um die monatlichen Kosten zu senken.

segments.src: ## The Broader Housing Market
segments.tr: ## Der breitere Immobilienmarkt

segments.src: Thin inventory has a ripple effect.
segments.tr: Dünne Bestände haben einen Welleneffekt.

segments.src: Fewer sales mean less activity for real estate agents, lenders, movers, and home-improvement retailers.
segments.tr: Weniger Verkäufe bedeuten weniger Aktivität für Immobilienmakler, Kreditgeber, Umzugsunternehmen und Baumärkte.

segments.src: It also reduces labor mobility, since workers may hesitate to take jobs in other cities if relocating means a costlier mortgage.
segments.tr: Sie verringern auch die Arbeitskräftemobilität, da Arbeitnehmer zögern könnten, Jobs in anderen Städten anzunehmen, wenn ein Umzug eine teurere Hypothek bedeutet.

segments.src: Economists have noted that such friction can weigh on productivity and regional economic growth over time.
segments.tr: Ökonomen haben festgestellt, dass solche Reibungsverluste mit der Zeit die Produktivität und das regionale Wirtschaftswachstum belasten können.

segments.src: At the same time, the lock-in effect has acted as a cushion against steep price declines.
segments.tr: Gleichzeitig hat der Lock-in-Effekt als Puffer gegen steile Preisrückgänge gewirkt.

segments.src: Because few owners are forced to sell, and many carry modest payments, the supply of distressed listings has stayed low.
segments.tr: Da nur wenige Eigentümer zum Verkauf gezwungen sind und viele niedrige Raten tragen, ist das Angebot an Notverkäufen gering geblieben.

segments.src: That is one reason prices have shown resilience despite weaker affordability.
segments.tr: Das ist ein Grund, warum die Preise trotz geringerer Erschwinglichkeit Widerstandsfähigkeit gezeigt haben.

segments.src: ## Heading Into the Fall
segments.tr: ## Auf dem Weg in den Herbst

segments.src: The fall is traditionally a slower season for home sales, and this year may be no exception.
segments.tr: Der Herbst ist traditionell eine ruhigere Jahreszeit für Hausverkäufe, und dieses Jahr bildet da möglicherweise keine Ausnahme.

segments.src: A few factors will shape what comes next:
segments.tr: Einige Faktoren werden bestimmen, was als Nächstes passiert:

segments.src: 1. **The path of long-term yields.** A meaningful drop in the 10-year Treasury yield would likely ease mortgage rates and could coax some owners off the sidelines.
segments.tr: 1. **Der Verlauf der langfristigen Renditen.** Ein signifikanter Rückgang der Rendite 10-jähriger Staatsanleihen würde die Hypothekenzinsen wahrscheinlich entlasten und einige Eigentümer dazu bewegen, aus der Deckung zu kommen.

segments.src: 2. **Inflation and labor data.** Reports on prices and jobs influence bond-market expectations and, in turn, mortgage pricing.
segments.tr: 2. **Inflations- und Arbeitsmarktdaten.** Berichte über Preise und Arbeitsplätze beeinflussen die Erwartungen am Anleihemarkt und damit auch die Hypothekenpreisgestaltung.

segments.src: 3. **New construction.** Builders have been a larger source of supply, and their pace of starts and incentives will matter.
segments.tr: 3. **Neubauten.** Bauträger waren eine größere Angebotsquelle, und das Tempo ihrer Baubeginne und Anreize wird von Bedeutung sein.

segments.src: 4. **Life events.** Over time, some owners will move regardless of rates, gradually loosening inventory.
segments.tr: 4. **Ereignisse im Leben.** Mit der Zeit werden einige Eigentümer unabhängig von den Zinssätzen umziehen, wodurch das Angebot schrittweise aufgelockert wird.

segments.src: ## Key Takeaways
segments.tr: ## Wichtige Erkenntnisse

segments.src: - A 10-year Treasury yield near 5% keeps new mortgage rates well above what many current owners pay.
segments.tr: - Eine Rendite 10-jähriger Staatsanleihen nahe 5 % hält neue Hypothekenzinsen weit über dem, was viele aktuelle Eigentümer zahlen.

segments.src: - Owners with low-rate loans have a strong financial reason to stay put, keeping listings scarce.
segments.tr: - Eigentümer mit zinsgünstigen Krediten haben einen starken finanziellen Grund, zu bleiben, wodurch die Angebote knapp bleiben.

segments.src: - Limited supply supports prices, even as affordability remains a hurdle for buyers.
segments.tr: - Ein begrenztes Angebot stützt die Preise, auch wenn die Erschwinglichkeit für Käufer eine Hürde bleibt.

segments.src: - Relief is likely to depend on lower long-term yields, more new construction, or a slow rise in life-driven moves.
segments.tr: - Eine Entlastung dürfte von niedrigeren langfristigen Renditen, mehr Neubauten oder einem langsamen Anstieg lebensbedingter Umzüge abhängen.

segments.src: ## Why a 5% Treasury Yield Matters

segments.tr: Chúng theo sát thị trường trái phiếu, và lợi suất trái phiếu kho bạc kỳ hạn 10 năm là chỉ số chuẩn được theo dõi chặt chẽ nhất.

segments.src: When that yield rises, lenders generally price mortgages higher.
segments.tr: Khi lợi suất đó tăng lên, các bên cho vay thường định giá các khoản thế chấp cao hơn.

segments.src: A sustained move toward 5% signals that borrowing costs could stay elevated for longer than many buyers and sellers had hoped.
segments.tr: Một xu hướng duy trì hướng tới mức 5% báo hiệu rằng chi phí vay có thể vẫn ở mức cao lâu hơn so với kỳ vọng của nhiều người mua và người bán.

segments.src: Several forces can keep long-term yields high:
segments.tr: Một số lực lượng có thể giữ cho lợi suất dài hạn ở mức cao:

segments.src: - **Inflation expectations:** If investors worry price growth will remain firm, they demand higher yields.
segments.tr: - **Kỳ vọng lạm phát:** Nếu các nhà đầu tư lo ngại tăng trưởng giá cả sẽ vẫn vững chắc, họ sẽ yêu cầu lợi suất cao hơn.

segments.src: - **Government borrowing:** Heavy issuance of Treasury debt can push yields up as the market absorbs more supply.
segments.tr: - **Vay nợ chính phủ:** Việc phát hành ồ ạt nợ trái phiếu kho bạc có thể đẩy lợi suất lên cao khi thị trường hấp thụ nhiều nguồn cung hơn.

segments.src: - **Monetary policy outlook:** Expectations that short-term rates will stay higher for longer can lift yields across the curve.
segments.tr: - **Triển vọng chính sách tiền tệ:** Kỳ vọng rằng lãi suất ngắn hạn sẽ duy trì ở mức cao lâu hơn có thể nâng lợi suất trên toàn bộ đường cong.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Sellers
segments.tr: ## Điều này có ý nghĩa gì đối với người bán

segments.src: Selling may unlock equity, but the next purchase will likely come with a higher monthly payment.

segments.src: Many choose to stay, renovate, or rent out the property instead.

segments.src: Those who must move, because of a job change, a growing family, a divorce, or retirement, often accept the cost, but they represent a smaller share of potential sellers than in typical years.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Buyers

segments.src: Affordability measures, which combine price, rate and income, remain strained for many first-time buyers.

segments.src: - Considering new construction, where builders sometimes offer rate buydowns or incentives.

segments.tr: - Tiết kiệm để trả trước nhiều hơn nhằm giảm chi phí hàng tháng.

segments.src: ## The Broader Housing Market
segments.tr: ## Thị trường nhà ở rộng lớn hơn

segments.src: Thin inventory has a ripple effect.
segments.tr: Hàng tồn kho khan hiếm có hiệu ứng lan tỏa.

segments.src: Fewer sales mean less activity for real estate agents, lenders, movers, and home-improvement retailers.
segments.tr: Ít giao dịch bán hơn có nghĩa là ít hoạt động hơn cho các đại lý bất động sản, bên cho vay, công ty vận chuyển và các nhà bán lẻ cải tạo nhà cửa.

segments.src: It also reduces labor mobility, since workers may hesitate to take jobs in other cities if relocating means a costlier mortgage.
segments.tr: Nó cũng làm giảm khả năng di chuyển của lực lượng lao động, vì người lao động có thể ngần ngại nhận công việc ở các thành phố khác nếu việc chuyển chỗ ở đồng nghĩa với một khoản vay thế chấp đắt đỏ hơn.

segments.src: Economists have noted that such friction can weigh on productivity and regional economic growth over time.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế đã lưu ý rằng sự ma sát như vậy có thể gây áp lực lên năng suất và tăng trưởng kinh tế khu vực theo thời gian.

segments.src: At the same time, the lock-in effect has acted as a cushion against steep price declines.
segments.tr: Đồng thời, hiệu ứng khóa chặt đã đóng vai trò như một tấm đệm chống lại sự sụt giảm giá mạnh.

segments.src: Because few owners are forced to sell, and many carry modest payments, the supply of distressed listings has stayed low.
segments.tr: Vì ít chủ sở hữu bị buộc phải bán, và nhiều người đang trả các khoản thanh toán khiêm tốn, nguồn cung các danh sách nhà bị tịch biên vẫn ở mức thấp.

segments.src: That is one reason prices have shown resilience despite weaker affordability.
segments.tr: Đó là một lý do tại sao giá cả vẫn cho thấy sự kiên cường bất chấp khả năng chi trả yếu hơn.

segments.src: ## Heading Into the Fall
segments.tr: ## Hướng tới mùa thu

segments.src: The fall is traditionally a slower season for home sales, and this year may be no exception.
segments.tr: Mùa thu theo truyền thống là mùa chậm hơn đối với doanh số bán nhà, và năm nay có thể cũng không ngoại lệ.

segments.src: A few factors will shape what comes next:
segments.tr: Một vài yếu tố sẽ định hình những gì xảy ra tiếp theo:

segments.src: 1. **The path of long-term yields.** A meaningful drop in the 10-year Treasury yield would likely ease mortgage rates and could coax some owners off the sidelines.
segments.tr: 1. **Xu hướng của lợi suất dài hạn.** Một sự sụt giảm đáng kể trong lợi suất trái phiếu kho bạc kỳ hạn 10 năm có khả năng sẽ làm giảm lãi suất thế chấp và có thể thuyết phục một số chủ sở hữu quay trở lại thị trường.

segments.src: 2. **Inflation and labor data.** Reports on prices and jobs influence bond-market expectations and, in turn, mortgage pricing.
segments.tr: 2. **Dữ liệu lạm phát và lao động.** Các báo cáo về giá cả và việc làm ảnh hưởng đến kỳ vọng của thị trường trái phiếu và từ đó, ảnh hưởng đến định giá thế chấp.

segments.src: 3. **New construction.** Builders have been a larger source of supply, and their pace of starts and incentives will matter.
segments.tr: 3. **Xây dựng mới.** Các nhà xây dựng đã là một nguồn cung lớn hơn, và tốc độ khởi công cũng như các ưu đãi của họ sẽ rất quan trọng.

segments.src: 4. **Life events.** Over time, some owners will move regardless of rates, gradually loosening inventory.
segments.tr: 4. **Các sự kiện trong cuộc sống.** Theo thời gian, một số chủ sở hữu sẽ chuyển đi bất kể lãi suất, dần dần làm nới lỏng hàng tồn kho.

segments.src: ## Key Takeaways
segments.tr: ## Những điểm chính cần lưu ý

segments.src: - A 10-year Treasury yield near 5% keeps new mortgage rates well above what many current owners pay.
segments.tr: - Lợi suất trái phiếu kho bạc kỳ hạn 10 năm gần 5% giữ cho lãi suất thế chấp mới cao hơn nhiều so với mức mà nhiều chủ sở hữu hiện tại đang trả.

segments.src: - Owners with low-rate loans have a strong financial reason to stay put, keeping listings scarce.
segments.tr: - Những chủ sở hữu có khoản vay lãi suất thấp có lý do tài chính mạnh mẽ để ở lại, khiến các danh sách nhà bán trở nên khan hiếm.

segments.src: - Limited supply supports prices, even as affordability remains a hurdle for buyers.
segments.tr: - Nguồn cung hạn chế hỗ trợ giá cả, ngay cả khi khả năng chi trả vẫn là một rào cản đối với người mua.

segments.src: - Relief is likely to depend on lower long-term yields, more new construction, or a slow rise in life-driven moves.
segments.tr: - Sự cứu trợ có khả năng phụ thuộc vào lợi suất dài hạn thấp hơn, nhiều công trình xây dựng mới hơn, hoặc sự gia tăng chậm chạp trong các vụ chuyển nhà do các sự kiện cuộc sống.
